places.name: Prague Castle (UNESCO)
places.ai_summary: Prague Castle is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and the largest ancient castle complex in the world, featuring stunning architecture.
places.place_tip: Visit early to avoid crowds and enjoy the sunrise view.

places.name: Charles Bridge
places.ai_summary: Charles Bridge is a historic stone bridge adorned with statues, offering picturesque views of the Vltava River and Prague skyline.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited early morning or late evening.

places.place_tip: Capture the sunrise for stunning photos.

places.name: Old Town Square & Astronomical Clock
places.ai_summary: The Old Town Square is the heart of Prague, featuring the Astronomical Clock, historic buildings, and vibrant street performances.
places.place_tip: Watch the Astronomical Clock show at the top of the hour.
places.address: Old Town Square, Prague, Czech Republic

places.name: St. Vitus Cathedral
places.ai_summary: St. Vitus Cathedral is a Gothic masterpiece and the most important church in the Czech Republic, located within Prague Castle.
places.place_tip: Climb the tower for panoramic views of Prague.
places.address: St. Vitus Cathedral, Prague, Czech Republic

places.name: Lesser Town (Malá Strana)
places.ai_summary: Lesser Town is a picturesque district in Prague, known for its baroque architecture, charming streets, and the iconic John Lennon Wall.
places.place_tip: Visit the John Lennon Wall and take a stroll along the Vltava River.

places.name: Jewish Quarter (Josefov)
places.ai_summary: The Jewish Quarter, known as Josefov, is a historic area in Prague with synagogues, a cemetery, and Jewish Museum, reflecting the city's Jewish heritage.
places.place_tip: Visit the Jewish Museum and the Old Jewish Cemetery.

places.name: Wenceslas Square
places.ai_summary: Wenceslas Square is a vibrant boulevard in Prague, famous for its historical significance, shops, and the National Museum.
places.place_tip: Visit the National Museum and explore the surrounding shops.

places.name: Petrin Tower & Hill Funicular
places.ai_summary: Petrin Tower is a mini Eiffel Tower offering stunning views of Prague. The hill funicular provides a scenic ride up Petrin Hill.
places.place_tip: Visit early to avoid crowds and enjoy the view.

attribution.title: Petřínská rozhledna, Prague
attribution.author: Ivan Korostelev

places.name: Dancing House (Fred & Ginger)
places.ai_summary: The Dancing House is a modern architectural marvel in Prague, resembling a pair of dancers. It houses a restaurant and offers city views.
places.place_tip: Enjoy a meal at the restaurant for a unique experience.

places.name: National Museum (Wenceslas Square)
places.ai_summary: The National Museum is a prominent cultural and historical institution in Prague, located at the top of Wenceslas Square.
places.place_tip: Explore the vast collections and exhibitions.

places.name: Vltava River Cruise
places.ai_summary: A Vltava River Cruise offers a unique perspective of Prague's landmarks, including the Charles Bridge and Prague Castle, from the water.
places.place_tip: Choose a cruise with dinner for a special experience.

places.name: Kampa Island & Museum
places.ai_summary: Kampa Island is a peaceful retreat in Prague, featuring a park, the Kampa Museum of Modern Art, and views of the Charles Bridge.
places.place_tip: Visit the Kampa Museum and enjoy a walk in the park.

places.name: John Lennon Wall
places.ai_summary: The John Lennon Wall is a symbol of peace and freedom, covered in Beatles-inspired graffiti and lyrics, located in the Lesser Town.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited early morning or late evening.

places.place_tip: Bring a marker to add your message to the wall.
places.address: John Lennon Wall, Prague, Czech Republic

places.name: Powder Tower
places.ai_summary: The Powder Tower is a Gothic tower in Prague, once used as a gunpowder store, now a monument and exhibition space.
places.place_tip: Climb to the top for a great view of the city.

places.name: Municipal House (Art Nouveau Hall)
places.ai_summary: The Municipal House is a stunning example of Art Nouveau architecture in Prague, featuring a concert hall and café.

opening_hours.notes: Concerts and events may affect visiting hours.

places.place_tip: Check the schedule for concerts and events.

places.name: Vyšehrad Fortress
places.ai_summary: Vyšehrad Fortress is a historic fort located on a hill overlooking the Vltava River, offering panoramic views of Prague.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited at sunrise or sunset.

places.place_tip: Explore the park and enjoy the views from the fort.

places.name: Letná Park Viewpoint
places.ai_summary: Letná Park Viewpoint offers a scenic overlook of Prague, located in Letná Park, ideal for picnics and relaxation.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Bring a blanket and enjoy a picnic with a view.

places.name: Prague Zoo
places.ai_summary: Prague Zoo is a top-rated zoo in the Czech Republic, known for its conservation efforts and diverse animal exhibits.
places.place_tip: Visit the zoo's website for feeding times and events.

places.name: Franz Kafka Museum
places.ai_summary: The Franz Kafka Museum is dedicated to the life and works of the famous writer Franz Kafka, located in a historic building in Prague.
places.place_tip: Explore the museum's exhibitions on Kafka's life and works.
places.address: Franz Kafka Museum, Prague, Czech Republic
